name: The comments desk
description: Admin only: THE COMMENTS DESK, one list at a time. `?view=held` is every held comment oldest first -- a held comment waits however long it takes; `reported` is every live or held comment a reader flagged, most reports first; `all` is every comment newest first. `?q=` narrows any of them: `@handle` to one author, anything else to a substring of the text. Each branch reads its own index and fifty rows: `all` pages by a keyset cursor, `held` and `reported` by an OFFSET, because a report count moves under a keyset. Each row is the whole comment in every state -- the desk reads what the public cannot -- with its author and their commenting switch, its host and thread (locked or not), and its reports: the count, the count per reason and the ten latest with their words. `counts` carries the tab badges. The detail pane's thread is GET /v1/threads, and its actions are the decide, lock and commenting routes.
